attr.title: Frozen Bubble
attr.desc: C++/SDL2 rewrite of the classic Frozen Bubble 2: pop coloured bubbles in 100 single player levels, local 2-player battles, or 2-5 player network games over LAN or the internet. Includes a launcher to set your nickname, join or host a server and assign controllers.
attr.inst: Ready to play. A setup screen opens first: choose Offline, Join a server or Host a server, then Play.
